decisions.statement: The account-wide table is read by the `temper-catalog-host` domain.
The account a capture is read for is the first the saved variables name.
The domain keys are the list `@akasha/temper-catalog-core` declares.
A domain page is reached by the slug its saved-variables key kebab-cases into.
A capture naming no apiVersion or manifestApiVersion changes no page.
A capture with no catalog domain changes no page.
A domain key no page has is reported and the other domains still change.
Saved variables with no readable account-wide table raise an error.
Every page one run reaches is given the same capture instant.
A caller may hand in the clock.
A caller may hand in the patch that changes a page.
A caller may hand in the reporter.
Nothing here opens the saved-variables file.
A capture for a second account is read by nothing here.

definition: a catalog capture's game build written onto every catalog domain page that capture has
